senses.gloss: (b. h.) to dig, esp. to take coals out with a pan.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 4:4">Yoma IV, 4</cite> <he>בכל יום היה חוֹתֶה וכ׳</he> every other day the priest used to take coals out in a silver pan &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:7">Sabb. VIII, 7</cite> <he>כדי לַחְתּוֹת בו את האור</he> large enough to take fire out in it.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 4:3:3">Y. Yoma IV, 41ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>צריך לחות</he> (read <he>לחתות</he>) he must take coals out as before.

<cite ref="Shabbat 34b:1">Sabb. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>שמא יְחַתֶּה בגחלים</he> he might rake the coals under the ashes. [<cite ref="Chullin 27a:8">Ḥull. 27ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01913"><he>חָתַת</he></cite>].
